dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?

dialogOption.emotions: around 50 years old , Kevin Spacey like
dialogOption.texten: There was an accident, please send an ambulance.
{WHAT HAPPENED?}Alright sir, you gonna have to tell me more, before I send an ambulance.
{I'LL SEND THE AMBULANCE}Just stand by the ambulance will be there shortly.
What more do you want to know?
{WHAT EXACTLY HAPPEN?}What exactly did happen? Who is injured?
A dog was hit by some asshole driver. I don't know how serious the injuries are, but it looks really bad.
{DOG?}A dog? You mean a dog is injured?
{ADDRESS} Where did it happen?
At [[ADDRESS]]
At 104 Doungton ave.
At 232 Roosevelt st.
At 478 Osmond blv.
Yes, a dog was run over by a car!
{CALL A VET} I can't send an ambulance for an injured dog. You will have to take it to a vet.
{TRY TO HELP} Is the dog in critical condition? Maybe you can help him by yourself.
I don't think so... It looks terrible. He can't really move... seems like there is something wrong with his spine.
I don't know if it makes sense. The dog probably will probably die before they arrive.
That dog is in enormous pain. Maybe I should kill it?
{DO IT} If there's no other way to help this dog, maybe you should.
{GIVE VET NUMBER} Sir, I strongly recommend you don't do that. I can give you the number to a good vet. Do you have something to write it down?
{SEND HELP} No! The situation is critical enough to send the ambulance. Please wait, the help is on the way.
You're right. My dad always said that they're two kinds of pain: the pain that makes you stronger or useless pain. That dog will never be stronger. There is no point to his suffering...
{DON'T DO IT!} No no Sir don't do that please! I'll send someone there right away, they will be there shortly!
It's over now. Sorry for an unnecessary call.

dialogOption.emotions: moment of silence at the beginning
dialogOption.texten: . . . . . . . . . It is not a good idea. Moments like this require somebody who will act. Who will do unpleasant, but necessary, things.
Thanks. I'll wait with it.
Can you hear me?

reportElement.texten: A dog was run over by a car.
Animal's condition was critical. Caller decided to inflict a mortal wound, that would end the dog's suffering.
